header: Using an OpenSearch Ingestion pipeline with Conﬂuent Cloud Kafka
content:
You can use an OpenSearch Ingestion pipeline to stream data from Conﬂuent Cloud Kafka clusters
to Amazon OpenSearch Service domains and OpenSearch Serverless collections. OpenSearch
Ingestion supports both public and private network conﬁgurations for the streaming of data from
Conﬂuent Cloud Kafka clusters to domains or collections managed by OpenSearch Service or
OpenSearch Serverless.
